title: A Find hit opens straight into the Source monitor at the moment
why: One click on 'trail sign' #1 put GX010494 in the Source at 0:00 with In–Out over the 4 s hit and the Lyman Lane sign on screen, plus a '+ add to cut' button. Last time hits opened into a hidden preview.

title: The transcript is there and clickable
why: Index › a clip › SAID block lists timed lines; clicking 'What's the red mean?' cued the Source to 00:00:12:22 with In–Out over the line. For a story editor this is the index.

title: Find says 'Nothing convincing like … in this footage'
why: Dog, hot tub, wipe-out, pizza all got that line instead of a confident list.

title: Asking the AI found the jump to the frame, and said what it had and hadn't looked at
why: Prompt: 'which clip has someone in the air off a jump…'. In 42 s it answered GX010490, airborne 20.0–20.3 s, shadow apart, lands 20.6 s with the milk jug, offered 19.4–21.2 s; and 'I didn't look at GX010492, so this comes from its written description only'. That is what Find could not do.

title: Hand-cutting works like an editor expects now
why: Source In/Out buttons stay put, Insert lands at the playhead and moves it to the end of the new shot; 8 inserts went in in story order at exactly the lengths I marked (46.9 s).

title: Re-running one look is clear and safe
why: Index › Look every 1 s on GX010492: tooltip said what it changes ('The cut does not change; Stop keeps what finished'), a Stop button while running, 79 s, the proposal stayed waiting, my own description was kept, and the new look found the chair ride.

title: Sideways clips are upright everywhere
why: GX010474/484/492 play upright in Source, posters, Find and both cuts; the Index explains 'flag ignored: the camera's sensor says it was shot upright'.
